findings.title: Fortinet Releases Security Hardening Release for Multiple Products
findings.summary_md: Fortinet announced coordinated security updates for FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail, and FortiAuthenticator available from October 22, 2026. The vendor said the releases include critical and high-severity fixes identified through AI-assisted testing and urged customers to prioritize patching internet-facing systems. Full PSIRT advisories with CVE identifiers and CVSS scores were scheduled for November 10, 2026.

findings.title: FortiOS 7.6.8, 7.4.13, 8.0.2 and 7.2.14: Fortinet's October 2026 Security Hardening Release, Ahead of the November 10 CVEs
findings.summary_md: cveo.tech noted Fortinet fixed critical flaws in FortiOS, FortiManager, and FortiAnalyzer without publishing CVE IDs or FG-IR advisories until November 10, 2026. It listed fixed versions including FortiOS 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13, and 7.2.14 and FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.12, and 7.2.13. The post advised installing the updates rather than waiting for advisory details.

findings.title: Fortinet Patches AI-Found Flaws in FortiOS, FortiManager
findings.summary_md: Cyber Kendra reported Fortinet released fixes for critical flaws found with frontier AI models, with CVE details withheld until November 10. It noted fixes land in FortiOS 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.13, and 7.2.14 and in FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer 8.0.2, 7.6.8, 7.4.12, and 7.2.13. No CVE identifiers or CVSS scores had been published at the time.

findings.title: Fortinet Security Hardening Release: Upgrade FortiOS, FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer Now, Advisories Due 10 November
findings.summary_md: Rescana detailed Fortinet's October 22, 2026 coordinated security updates and the October 21 CISO announcement, including affected and fixed versions across FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail, and FortiAuthenticator. It reported no known exploitation as of October 23 and recommended prioritizing internet-facing devices and checking whether FortiManager Cloud instances need a manual update.

findings.title: Critical vulnerabilities in FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiMail, and other Fortinet products
findings.summary_md: Beacon Lab's alert summarized the coordinated October 21-22, 2026 Fortinet hardening release covering FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail, and FortiAuthenticator. It noted Fortinet would publish CVE identifiers, CVSS scores, and technical details on its PSIRT page on November 10, 2026, and urged applying patches before that date.

findings.title: Fortinet Products Multiple Vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: HKCERT published a bulletin on October 23, 2026 rating the risk as medium and advising users to apply the relevant Fortinet updates promptly. It noted technical details were scheduled for disclosure on November 10, 2026 and that HKCERT would reassess the risk level as details emerged.

findings.title: Fortinet Fixes Before Disclosure: A Sysadmin Checklist for the Window Before 10 November
findings.summary_md: The post outlined Fortinet's October 22, 2026 fixed builds and the planned November 10 advisory publication, providing an administrator checklist for the pre-disclosure window. It emphasized identifying FortiManager and FortiOS instances, saving configurations before upgrading, and monitoring logs for unusual administrative access.
